verdict.rationale: GitHub states it provides CI/CD ('Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD'), and GitHub Actions automates software development workflows directly in the repository. Marketplace integrations such as Render, Shopify push-to-deploy and mobile CI/CD services extend this to deployment targets. Community reports confirm teams use GitHub's CI/CD in practice, though one user notes frequent Actions outages. missing for 10: first-party docs specifically on deployment workflows (e.g. environments, deployment jobs, approvals), hands-on corroboration of deployments themselves rather than general CI/CD use.
